group: Round 6 · Loot: item icons and pickup kit (loaded by the game)
title: Item icons: weapons 2 (legendary and new)
use: Icons for the 11 legendary weapons of loot.js (backbiter to trident_blade) and the 5 new weapons of loot-design.md (hunter_knives, fury_lash, minotaur_horn, chimera_fang, procrustes_axe).
prompt: A sheet of 16 game item icons in a grid of 4 columns by 4 rows, one item per 256-pixel cell, read left to right and top to bottom in exactly this order: 1. Backbiter, a sword whose blade is half celestial bronze and half grey steel, split down the middle; 2. Stygian Iron Blade, a black sword that seems to drink the light, wisps of shadow; 3. Twin Huntress Knives, two crossed silver hunting knives; 4. Imperial Gold Gladius, a short Roman sword of shining gold; 5. Harpe of Perseus, a bronze sword with a sickle hook near the tip; 6. Club of Heracles, a huge olive-wood club studded with bronze; 7. Pelian Spear of Achilles, a tall ash spear with a gleaming bronze point; 8. Burning Sword of Ares, a broad red-bronze sword wreathed in flames, a boar's head on the guard; 9. Axe of Boreas, an icy blue-white axe with frost and icicles; 10. Spear of the Storm, a spear with lightning coiling along the shaft; 11. Tide-Forged Sword, a sea-green bronze sword with a wave curling along the blade; 12. Hunter's Moon Knives, a pair of slim silver crescent knives; 13. Fury's Flaming Lash, a black leather whip wreathed in fire with a bronze handle; 14. Horn of the Minotaur, a huge curved bull's horn with a wrapped grip, used as a blade; 15. Chimera Fang Spear, a spear tipped with a big green-dripping fang, a snake-scale grip; 16. Procrustes's Cleaver, a long cruel bronze cleaver-axe with a bed-frame motif on the haft. Inventory icons in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: each item a small chunky 3D voxel model seen from a high three-quarter angle, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading and a small highlight, a bold silhouette that still reads at 64 pixels, celestial bronze that glows faintly, magic parts with a soft glow. Each icon is centred in its own square cell with even padding and never touches its neighbours; no frame, border, rarity colour, number or label in the cells (the game adds those). The whole sheet sits on a perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background with no gradient, texture or cast shadow, so the background can be removed. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
